title: Handling Withheld on a Return Credit where Credit Memos Are Already Standing, Crop Input Purchasing Accounts
content:
The handling figure withheld from a return credit — the figure that covers bringing product back across the scale and re-shelving it — rises on an account that has already had credit memos written on it in the season.

**Clause.** Where three or more credit memos already stand on the account over the 10 statement months before the handling date, the handling figure withheld is the programme's after-hours delivery charge. Where one or two credit memos stand on the account over those months, the handling figure withheld is the programme's under-minimum delivery charge. In every other case no substituted handling figure is withheld on the Crop Input Purchasing Accounts.

## The count and the figure

| Credit memos standing over the 10 statement months | Handling figure withheld |
| --- | --- |
| 3 or more | The programme's after-hours delivery charge |
| 1 or 2 | The programme's under-minimum delivery charge |
| none | No substituted handling figure |

## The two charges, programme by programme

| Programme | After-hours delivery charge (USD) | Under-minimum delivery charge (USD) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Cash Purchase Account | 120 | 75 |
| Standard 30-Day Charge Account | 120 | 75 |
| Seasonal Terms Crop Input Account | 120 | 50 |
| Early Pay Prepay Program Account | 120 | 50 |
| Full Acre Input Financing Account | 90 | 0 |
| Precision Partner Input Program Account | 0 | 0 |

A member on the Seasonal Terms Crop Input Account with two credit memos already standing over the window therefore has 50.00 USD withheld as handling; a third credit memo standing over the window carries the withheld figure to 120.00 USD.
